proof_body:
by
  intro n a x
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hasDerivAt_const x (a 0)
  | succ m ih =>
    have h := ih.fun_add ((hasDerivAt_pow (m + 1) x).const_mul (a (m + 1)))
    simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ _ (m + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ _ m] at h ⊢
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    ring
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k * y ^ k) (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k : ℝ) + 1) * a (k + 1) * x ^ k) x
